description: This file contains utility functions for processing A2A protocol messages, including extracting text from messages and responses, counting tokens, and calculating usage statistics. It defines the A2ARequestUtils class with static methods and some backward compatibility functions.

classes.name: A2ARequestUtils
classes.description: Utility class for A2A request/response processing, providing static methods for message parsing and token counting.

methods.name: extract_text_from_message
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates text parts from an A2A message object or dict.

methods.name: extract_text_from_response
methods.description: Extracts text content from an A2A response dictionary.

methods.name: get_input_message_from_request
methods.description: Retrieves the input message object from an A2A request.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in a given text using litellm.token_counter.

methods.name: calculate_usage_from_request_response
methods.description: Calculates token usage (prompt, completion, total) from request and response.
